issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, allowing path/query/fragment injection and route confusion.
Backoff jitter is added after applying backoff_cap, so actual sleep can exceed the configured cap.
Retry-After parsing only supports numeric seconds and ignores the HTTP-date form allowed by the header standard.
Transient httpx transport errors are not retried or wrapped, so callers receive raw network exceptions despite retry support.
Successful responses are parsed without schema checks, causing KeyError/AttributeError/ValueError instead of typed client errors on malformed API responses.
BatchItemResult and ReviewResult do not validate literal fields, so invalid status or verdict values can enter typed models.
Scripted mock responses bypass API key validation, which can hide authentication regressions in tests.
Mock batch creation assumes every task item is a dict, so malformed input can crash the mock instead of returning a contract error.
Development tooling only includes pytest, with no configured formatter, linter, type checker, or coverage gate.
Package version is duplicated separately from pyproject.toml, creating an avoidable release drift risk.
